description:
List a conservation credit on the book. verification_ref (a D-Score /
    land-verification attestation) is REQUIRED — unverified credits cannot
    enter the book. To trade on the Verra network, pass registry="verra" with
    the VCS provenance (vcs_project_id, serial_number, vintage, methodology) so
    retirements are cross-referenceable on registry.verra.org.

issuer.description: Id of the party listing the credit.
issuer.title: Issuer

mass_g.description: Grams of CO2e, a whole number.
mass_g.title: Mass G

methodology.description: Optional. The methodology code, for example VM0047.
methodology.title: Methodology

price_minor_per_kg.description: Price per kilogram in minor units (cents).
price_minor_per_kg.title: Price Minor Per Kg

registry.description: Optional. verra to trade on the Verra network.
registry.title: Registry

serial_number.description: Verra serial number range, when registry is verra.
serial_number.title: Serial Number

vcs_project_id.description: Verra VCS project id, when registry is verra.
vcs_project_id.title: Vcs Project Id

verification_ref.description: Required. The verification attestation or registry id.
verification_ref.title: Verification Ref

vintage.description: Credit vintage year, when registry is verra.
vintage.title: Vintage

name: list_credit
title: List credit
